The V2xBtp module shall implement the Basic Transport Protocol (BTP) as specified in [6], unless specified otherwise in this document
The BTP protocol shall meet the BTP related requirements specified in [19] and support the scenarios specified in [20].
The V2xBtp Module shall encapsulate the payload from the V2xFac module with a BTP B header only as specified in [6] chapter 6 with the header format and structure as specified in chapter 7.

If a packet received by the V2xBTP with a port number that matches a port number contained in one of the containers configured in V2xBtpDestinationPort , the V2xBtp module shall call the function with the corresponding name configured in this container V2xBtpRxIndicationFunctionName to pass the payload and the GeoNetworking parameters to the V2xFac module.…

The V2xBtp module shall get the data (BTP packet) and the GeoNetworking parameters of a received GeoNetworking packet via the V2xBtp_RxIndication() callback. This callback shall be triggered by the V2xGn module once a GN packet is received from the peer GN entity.
The V2xBtp module shall provide the API V2xBtp_Transmit() to service transmit requests from the V2xFac module.
Source protocol operations when V2xBtp_Transmit() is triggered shall be as specified in [6] chapter 8.2.

The V2xBtp module transmits BTP packets to a peer BTP entity using the V2xGn_Transmit() API provided by the V2xGn module. The parameters for V2xGn_Transmit() shall be set according to [6] chapter 8.2. The parameters are provided to the V2xBtp module by the V2xFac module with a call to V2xBtp_Transmit() .

The V2xBtp module shall employ BTP-B headers. Consequently, the GeoNetworking common header shall use a value of 2 for the NH field.
The V2xBtp module shall set the destination port info field to the value 0.
The function V2xFac_Init (refer to chapter 8.3.2) of the V2xFac shall initialize the internal states of the V2xFac module.
The function V2xFac_Init shall initialize the basic services CA and DEN for transmission and the reception service for all message types as per configuration.
CA basic service initialization shall enable the transmission of CAM messages.
The function V2xFac_Init shall initialize the parameter T_GenCam_DCC [1] needed for the frequency management for CAMs according to T_GenCamMax [1]. For details see [1] chapter 5.3.5 and [15].
The function V2xFac_Init shall initialize the parameter T_GenCam [1] to the default value T_GenCamMax. For details see [1] chapter 6.1.3
The function V2xFac_Init shall initialize the parameter N_GenCam [1] to the default value 0.
The function V2xFac_Init shall initialize the parameter T_CheckCamGen [1] to the default value equal to the configuration parameter T_GenCamMin [1]. For details see [1] chapter 6.1.3
The CA basic service shall periodically generate CAMs controlled by a CAM frequency management (For details see [1] chapter 6.1.3 and [14].)
The generated CAMs shall be transmitted by the V2xBtp using the API function V2xBtp_Transmit() (see [SWS_V2xFac_00092]).
The CA basic service shall receive CAMs via the callback function V2xFac_RxIndication() .
The CAM generation shall follow time requirements according to [1] chapter 6.1.5 and [15].
The function V2xFac_Init shall initialize an empty originating ITS-S message table. For details see [3] chapter 8.2.1.6

The DEN basic service is triggered by the V2x-Application via its service operations TriggerEvent, UpdateEvent or TerminateEvent from the service interface V2xFacDenBs . The function parameter "EventID" given by the above mentioned operations shall be mapped by the DEN basic service to the actionID generated for DENMs. For details see [3] chapter 5.3 and 8.2

Upon receiving a DENM, the DEN basic service makes the content of the DENM available to the V2X Applications. Received DENMs shall be sent to the upper application layer via their standardized AUTOSAR service interface V2xApplRxIndicationDenm. Specification of Vehicle-2-X Facilities AUTOSAR CP R21-11 26 of 345 Document ID 795: AUTOSAR_SWS_V2XFacilities For…
In between two consequent DENM updates, a DENM may be repeated by the DEN basic service. For details see [3] chapter 6.1.2.3
